project.name: Car Service Station Management SaaS
project.tagline: Bookings, job cards, parts, billing, staff pay and customer history for independent car service stations in Pakistan
project.status: APPROVED 2026-11-13 — development handoff (no code built yet)
approved_sources: PRD.md v1.1 (APPROVED, 61 active REQs, REQ-011 deprecated)
TASKS.md v1.0 (APPROVED plan, 75 tasks, all NOT_STARTED)
Styling: neutral default colour — provisional design, no brand assets supplied

overview.problem: Workshops run on paper job cards, registers and spreadsheets: parts used on a car are not always billed, stock and supplier dues are hard to track, customers cannot see progress, and owners lack daily cash and staff-performance figures.
overview.solution: A multi-tenant SaaS with fully isolated data per station. Web dashboard for owner, manager and cashier; Android Staff app (mechanic work offline up to 24 h); Android Customer app for booking, estimate approval, tracking and invoices. Three plans: Basic PKR 2,500, Standard PKR 5,000, Premium PKR 8,000 per month; yearly = 10 months' price; 14-day full trial.
overview.audience: Independent car service stations in Pakistan (one branch each at launch), their staff and mechanics, their customers, and the platform owner as super admin. English UI, PKR, Pakistani formats.
mvp: MOD-001…MOD-010, one branch per station, web + Android Staff app + Android Customer app (direct APK)
Job cards with checklist (no photos), estimate approval and extra-work re-approval
Parts by piece / litre / partial drum / kit, supplier purchases and ledger, low-stock alerts
Invoices with optional sales tax (NTN/STRN), split payments, approved credit, refunds by credit note, daily cash closing
Booking with owner-set bay capacity and no-show blocking (Standard+)
WhatsApp: manual prefilled send on all plans; automatic from the station's own connected account on Standard+ (CR-002)
Staff attendance, payroll with commission and advances (Premium)
Approvals inbox, owner-only audit log, reports with Excel export
non_goals: Urdu/RTL UI, FBR e-invoicing, Play Store listing, inspection photos (later)
SMS for customer messages and any platform message quota (removed by CR-002; SMS only for login codes)
In-app online payment by customers, marketplace/station search, white-label domains, general ledger accounting

roles.name: Platform Super Admin
permissions: Tenants, plans, trials, suspensions
Verify bank/cash subscription payments
Usage counts only — no station records without an owner-granted, time-limited support grant (REQ-005, REQ-012)

roles.name: Station Owner
permissions: Everything in the station: settings, prices, discount limit, tax
Sees profit, purchase cost, audit log, payroll
Approves discounts over limit, refunds, stock adjustments, credit release (REQ-057)
Connects the station's WhatsApp account (REQ-061)

roles.name: Manager
permissions: Job cards, bookings, assignment, quality check
Daily attendance (same day)
Approval rights delegated by owner by default
No profit, payroll or audit log

roles.name: Cashier / Service Advisor
permissions: Intake, estimates, invoices, payments
Discount up to owner-set limit (default 5%)
Requests approvals; sends manual WhatsApp (REQ-062)

roles.name: Mechanic
permissions: Only assigned jobs, no prices
Checklist, stages up to quality check, parts used
Works offline up to 24 h (REQ-023)

roles.name: Customer
permissions: One phone login across linked stations (REQ-047)
Book free slots, approve estimates and extra work
Track status, view invoices, dues and history

journeys.name: J1 Booking to delivery (Standard)
steps: Customer books free slot in app
Arrives; job card with odometer, fuel, checklist
Mechanic adds parts (offline OK) and syncs
journeys.outcome: Stock reduced, invoice paid, customer informed via push and station WhatsApp

journeys.name: J2 Walk-in on Basic plan
steps: Discount above limit needs owner login
journeys.outcome: Paid invoice; money control kept with the owner

journeys.name: J3 Stock in
journeys.outcome: Correct stock value and supplier ledger

journeys.name: J4 Credit release
steps: Vehicle delivered; due in customer ledger
journeys.outcome: Vehicle leaves only with approval; dues tracked

journeys.name: J5 Subscription lapse
journeys.outcome: Station keeps its data; access restored immediately on payment

journeys.name: J6 Month end payroll (Premium)
steps: Salary by paid days + commission on paid labour − advances

layers.name: Clients (Flutter)
components: Staff app (Android 8+, local SQLite + change queue)

layers.name: Supabase — Mumbai ap-south-1
components: Auth (password; phone OTP via SMS hook)
Postgres with row-level security per station
Business rules in SQL functions (one transaction each)
Append-only stock, payment, ledger and audit tables

layers.name: External services
components: WhatsApp Cloud API — each station's own account via Embedded Signup
Local SMS aggregator — login codes only

flows: Every money/stock/stage change goes through a named SQL function that checks role, plan, read-only state and validation, then writes ledgers and audit
Staff app offline: local write → change queue → sync_apply (idempotent by client_change_id) → last change wins, loser kept in history, manager alerted
Event → message outbox → automatic send from the station's WhatsApp account, or the manual Messages-to-send list with a prefilled wa.me link
Subscription: checkout → provider webhook (signature checked, status re-queried) → plan activated; bank/cash verified by super admin
Backups: Supabase daily (7-day retention) + weekly off-site copy; quarterly restore drill
trust_boundaries: Apps hold only the public URL and anon key; all access enforced by row-level security
Provider keys and station WhatsApp tokens live only in Edge Function secrets
Mechanic devices never receive prices or purchase costs; server re-validates every uploaded change
Super admin sees station data only during an owner-granted, time-limited, read-only support grant

data.name: Station operations (jobs, invoices, payments, stock, staff)
data.source: Staff entry on web and Staff app
data.retention: While account active; deleted 90 days after closing

data.name: Customers and vehicles
data.source: Staff entry, Excel import, customer app
data.retention: Same as station data; customer account per phone links to stations

data.name: Subscription payments
data.source: Payment aggregator webhooks; super admin verification

security: Cross-station isolation tests on every table in CI (TEST-003)
Discount, credit, refund and stock rules enforced on the server, not only in the UI
No deletion of money or stock records — reversal with reason only (REQ-042)
Webhook signature checks + idempotency; OTP rate limit (5 per hour per phone, ARCHITECTURE §6)
Signed APKs from our HTTPS domain; keystore kept offline with two copies
Read-only mode on subscription lapse blocks writes in the database
Targets: screens < 3 s on 4G, 99.5% monthly availability, 24 h offline for mechanics

tasks: TASK-001…TASK-009: repo + CI, Supabase Mumbai, hosting, Meta Tech Provider, SMS OTP, payment aggregator, own-sync spike, Flutter web spike, printer/scanner spike

risks: Own offline sync must be correct (ordering, duplicates, conflicts) — dedicated test suite, real-device spike (R5)
Meta Tech Provider and template approval delays — manual WhatsApp covers the gap (R2)
Stations may find Meta sign-up / payment method hard — guide, video and onboarding support (R1)
Payment aggregator merchant approval time — bank/cash manual path still works (R3)
Direct-APK installs and updates may put customers off — install guide, in-app updater (R6)
Schedule ≈ 9 months to launch assumes 2 developers + part-time QA (ASSUMED)
Running cost ≈ US$40–50/month fixed is an estimate; prices to be verified in Phase 0
